item.text:
Implemented and tested:

```sh
./run.sh <audio.wav> <out.json>
```

Uses AssemblyAI’s `en_uk` setting. The sample produced “organise”, “colour”, “centre”, and “catalogued”.

Writes exactly `transcript_id` and `text`. Success exits 0; failures exit non-zero. Dependencies are installed.

Test result: [sample-output.json](/work/sample-output.json).
